plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: General development tooling skills, and the pr-reviewer and verifier agents.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Process and workflow skills (planning, grilling, research, writing).

plugins.name: in-progress
plugins.description: Skills being actively authored or rewritten. Installable for dogfooding; expect churn until they graduate.

plugins.name: guard-worktree
plugins.description: Mod: refuses edits in a repo's main checkout until the work moves to a worktree off a freshly fetched origin default branch.

plugins.name: guard-infra
plugins.description: Mod: asks the user to Run or Cancel each aws, aws-vault, kubectl, helm, or terraform apply/destroy call that is not a read.

plugins.name: watch-prs
plugins.description: Mod: watches the PRs a session touches, adds their live state to each prompt, and starts a turn on Copilot reviews, failed checks, and merges.

plugins.name: tidy-transcript
plugins.description: Mod: folds each run of tool calls into one line, a mod's prompt into one line, and older long replies to their first lines.

plugins.name: show-session
plugins.description: Mod: /show-session opens a pane with the session's skills, folders, shell commands, and agents.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Skills for maintaining this marketplace itself (import, refresh, merge). Not useful in other repos.

plugins.name: deprecated
plugins.description: Skills phased out. Still installable to ease the transition; will be removed once unused.
